item.title: About
item.description: This is a small place on the internet I created for myself to write. I consider myself and embedded software engineer, with interest in music, coding, cryptography and nature. My primary goal is to write techincal articles about things I have learnt. I want to write about things the way I percieved them. The idea is to make it as simple and as short as possible for everyone on the internet.

item.title: Syncing This Blog Straight From a Private Git Repo
item.description: Why this blog is a folder of markdown files and a push, not a CMS login.
